title: EMH (Electromagnetic Hazards) Specialist Systems Engineer (d/f/m)
description:
****Job Description:****
 In order to support the Site Engineering Team in Finkenwerder, Airbus is looking for an
   

  

****EMH (Electromagnetic Hazards) Specialist Systems Engineer (d/f/m)****
 Are you ready to pioneer the next generation of electrified and green aircraft and their system designs? Are you passionate about ensuring the continuity and modernization of the current Airbus aircraft family and derivatives? We are looking for technical leaders to join our design teams and shape the future of aircraft systems.
   

  

 If you thrive in a multicultural and transnational environment, maintain a proactive and solution\-oriented mindset, and possess a deep interest in protecting aircraft against Electromagnetic Hazards (EMH), we want to hear from you.
   

  

 As a Systems Engineer \& Specialist in the field of EMH within the Aircraft Systems Engineering domain (1YD) at Airbus Commercial, you will directly influence the definition of aircraft system designs. With the increasing electrification of aircraft components\-ranging from advanced connectivity systems in the cabin to new propulsion technologies\-focusing on Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) and Electromagnetic Hazards (EMH) is becoming more critical than ever.
   

  

 You will be involved in all development phases: from early concept and design through to certification of our product lines and in\-service support of the flying fleet. This role offers the opportunity to work within a highly recognized and multi cultural specialist team in the environmental qualification and system standard parts department.
   

  

 Your mission is to ensure platform protection against Lightning Induced Effects (LIE), High\-Intensity Radiated Fields (HIRF), and Electromagnetic Environmental Effects.
   

  

**Your location**
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.
   

  

**Our Benefits For You**
* Professional Growth: Evolve within a transnational department covering the full aircraft development cycle.
* Expanded Knowledge: Deepen your expertise in aircraft architecture, system competence, and certification processes.
* Diverse Scope: Take responsibility for a variety of fields, including EMH, standardization, electrical architectures, and environmental qualification.
* Networking: Build relationships across almost all Airbus organizations, including Design Teams, Flight Tests, and cross\-divisional partners (Airbus Helicopters, Airbus Defence and Space
* Fair Compensation \& Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
* Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35\-hour week); work\-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part\-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
* Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group\-wide career perspectives.
* Feel Good at Work: On\-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
* Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.


**Your Tasks And Responsibilities**
**Your Key responsibilities include:**
* Defining and implementing EMH requirements for new and modified systems, including identifying applicable certification requirements.
* Analyzing aircraft system architectures regarding EMH protection and managing activities within the certification process.
* Defining the work scope for EMH activities, assigning tasks to internal and external partners, and steering engineering workflows.
* Interfacing with all Airbus Engineering departments and divisions (including strong collaboration with Airbus Defence and Space) to ensure the design of safe, mature, and robust systems across all ATA chapters and programs.


**Your responsibilities are the following:**
* You will define and continuously improve the electromagnetic requirements applicable for the qualification of the systems and you will be as well the reference specialist to cooperate with the system design teams.
* You will validate the compliance of designs against requirements in accordance to the airworthiness regulations
* You will lead advanced studies to answer programme requests and needs or to solve in\-service problems on the flying fleet.
* You will create laboratory, ground and flight tests requests and will be responsible for the flight tests analysis and conclusions.
* You will lead certification processes, create certification plans and certification summaries together with the authorities and answer certification review items with dedicated reports and summaries (CRI)


**Desired Skills And Qualifications**
* Education: Master Degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a similar field.
* Technical Skills: A strong understanding of electrical and physical principles; analytical capability and a curiosity for electrical engineering.
* Soft Skills: Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex topics; a team\-oriented mindset that embraces transnational exchange.
* Experience: A solid understanding of the Aircraft Certification Process and more than 5 years of experience
* Languages: Negotiation\-level English and German. French would be a plus.


 This position will require a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.
   

  

 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.
   

  

 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!
   

  

 This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.
   

  

********Company:********
 Airbus Operations GmbH
   

  

**Employment Type:**
 Permanent
   

  

**Experience Level:**
 Professional
   

  

**Job Family:**
 Elec.Electron.\&Electromag,Optics\&Optron.
   

  

 By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
   

  

 Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.
   

  

 Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com .
   

  

 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
